info.text:
The Fed froze interest rates, but two officials wanted them higher.
On Oct 28, 2026 the Fed held its key rate at 3.75%-4%.
The vote was 10-2: Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack wanted a quarter-point hike.
The statement cites strong growth and elevated inflation. Next meeting: Dec 8-9.
Sources: Federal Reserve FOMC statement (Oct 28, 2026), CNBC, NBC News.
News and education, not financial advice.
